summary: A pile of stones on a battlement, which players throw over the wall with the game's stone throwing. The server counts the stones and decides the damage: full at the point of impact, falling to a quarter at the edge of the radius. Events are stonePileSpawn, stonePileThrow, stoneImpact and stonePileDestroy.

spawn.summary: Places a pile with endless stones, usable, with damage 60 and a 1.5 m radius.

params.orientation: Optional: Euler degrees or a Quaternion. None by default.
params.dimension: Optional: by default, the shared one.

spawn.exampleLua:
local pile = kcds.world.StonePile.spawn(kcds.math.Vector3.new(100, 200, 22))
pile.stones = 20
pile.damage = 80

kcds.core.Events.on("stoneImpact", function(source, where, thrower)
  print("player " .. tostring(thrower.id) .. " dropped a stone at " .. tostring(where))
end)

all.summary: All piles, or those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

getById.summary: The pile with this network id, or null.

destroyAll.summary: Removes all piles, or those in one dimension, and returns how many.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

stones.summary: Stones left, where -1 never runs out. You can assign to it.

usable.summary: Whether players can take stones. You can assign to it.

damage.summary: Damage at the point of impact, 0 to 1000. You can assign to it.

blastRadius.summary: How far damage reaches, 0 to 10 m. You can assign to it.
